description: Registers an MCP server, skill or plugin (human session free; agent without session = 402 $0.10). A person reviews it by hand; poll `status_api` (`GET /api/listings/:id/status`, no credential) to learn the decision. Two doors to the same action. Human with a session: free, 1 per day, at most 3 in the queue. Agent (with or without a guest): **402 with `accepts[]`**, $0.10 — pay and repeat. For a skill, the `SKILL.md` URL is enough; the rest is checked. **Validates before charging:** a refused body (400) and an exhausted quota (429) come BEFORE the 402, so no payment settles for a listing already known not to get in. A valid body without payment keeps receiving the 402 with the price.

category.description: Category so the listing shows up under the right filter.

url.description: MCP endpoint, SKILL.md URL, the plugin's repository or the OKF bundle's `index.md`. For an OKF bundle on a domain you control, `POST /api/okf/ping` is free.
